settings.intro: Choose your Atiny Atlas language and manage your account security.

admin.title: Administration
admin.ownerIntro: Manage administrator roles and suspend or reactivate accounts. Each change is recorded privately.
admin.adminIntro: Manage administrator roles for other accounts and suspend or reactivate fan accounts. Each change is recorded privately. Only the owner can suspend administrators.

settingsPanel.title: Operational settings
settingsPanel.intro: Set moderation, the letter limit, and the interval between new letters.

settingsPanel.limitsHint: Control how many letters each account can publish and the time between submissions.

moderation.title: Message moderation
moderation.intro: Review letters without changing their text. Each decision is recorded privately.
moderation.searchLabel: Search by letter text, author name or letter ID
moderation.note: Private note (optional, shared with the author)

moderation.invalid: Check the filters, version, reason and note before trying again.

moderation.transition: This decision is no longer available. Reload and review the letter.
moderation.error: Could not save the decision. Try again.
moderation.noDecisions: No decisions are available for this state.

suspension.hideWarning: Suspending this account hides all their letters and blocks publishing and editing. They can still read and delete their letters.
suspension.restoreWarning: Reactivation restores visibility under the current moderation rules. Rejected and withdrawn letters stay hidden.

suspension.confirmReinstate: Confirm reactivating {name} under the current visibility rules.

suspension.invalid: Check the reason, note and account version.
suspension.conflict: This account changed. Reload before trying again.
suspension.error: Could not update the account. Try again.

suspensionNotice.title: Your account is suspended
suspensionNotice.explanation: Your letters are hidden. You cannot publish or edit, but you can still read and delete your letters.

about.title: About us
about.purpose: This fan project was created to show our 8 pirates how much they are loved by ATINY.
about.community: It is a space to bring ATINYs together, share our love for ATEEZ and spread positivity throughout the fandom.
about.messages: Every message on this map is a little piece of love from ATINY coming together from all around the world.
about.origin: The original idea for this project came from angelppudding, with the help and support of breakthewalln109 and koala_hala.
